How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Start looking for housing as soon as you know you’re going

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Both pros and cons. Can be more difficult to meet other students but you have way more freedom.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: There was a drop period where you could switch classes. That worked fine. Only problem was that some classes were filled as full time students had the opportunity to choose their classes before exchange students.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I ended up getting all the classes I wanted, but had to pay a late registration fee as there came some extra spots in a class I wanted after the normal drop period.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Just go on the waiting list even though there are many people in front of you.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Lectures were on a high enough level but it was easy to get a good grade with relatively low effort.

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
Did you take BA or MA courses at your host university? *
Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: I mostly took 400 level courses which is on the border between BA and MA.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Only lectures. So no classical teaching with an instructor.

questions.answer: Go on the outdoor frosh. Preferably the camping as it seems that there are a lot of exchange students there

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: There are a lot of cultural things to do in Montreal. Great museums, restaurants and bars. Also a lot of beautiful nature around the city. Rent a car and drive out to see some of it.

questions.answer: Surprised on the amount of french

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Learn some french
Go on the outdoor frosh
Don’t be scared of the level in the lectures as the tests are way easier that the stuff they teach.
